_comment: Permission-gate rule severities — this file is the single control surface; no severity decisions live in code. Per rule: "off" = silent, "warn" = note and proceed, "error" = block. Legacy values still parse: 0/1/2 and true/false. A key that is missing or set to garbage fails closed to "error" with a stderr warning. One-off override without editing: PGATE_<SCREAMING_SNAKE_KEY>=off|warn|error (e.g. PGATE_RERUN_GUARD=off). Safety floor: destructiveConfirm and commitMessageLint cannot be configured below "error". Rule IDs (R1, P3, ...) are the internal cross-reference used in source comments and the README rule table; keys here are the stable, human-readable names. outputCap/confirm/destructive tune numeric limits and the confirm command list.
